title: Relics of the old age
by: Dev (local model), checked by the writing room

items.text: The stair under Eliet's well was cut by the first cultivators, going down. Every step of it is older than any sect in the valley.
The Hollow Clans counted their beasts on sticks like this. The oldest stick has one notch. Someone came down with a single beast and built a clan.

items.sealed_well_cap: Someone sealed the stair under Eliet's well, from below, a long time ago. The seal held until the water dropped and the lid rusted through.

items.text: The Lattice carried qi through conduits like this, up from the Heart. On the night of the Sundering every one of them cracked at once.
The first masters sealed the Heart's chamber with a spell. Centuries later, the Makers broke it to build the swarm, setting the Sundering in motion.
The first masters sealed the Heart's chamber when they died, to keep it pure. The Makers broke that seal. Everything after began there.
The Lattice carried qi through conduits like this, up from the Heart. On the night of the Sundering every one of them cracked at once.
The old map shows a line of towers rising from the Heart. They fell in the Sundering, leaving only a rusted bell as proof of their height.
The first masters carved their wisdom on the walls of the Heart chamber: 'Heaven is not up. It is in. The breath goes all the way down.'
The Makers' first scouts climbed a tower and saw a world of stone and light, but no sky. They came back down and wrote the Lattice's first line.
The deep crevices hold notes from those who fell: 'The Heart is not the goal. The journey is the climb.'
Someone sealed the stair under Eliet's well, from below, a long time ago. The seal held until the water dropped and the lid rusted through.
The Hollow Clans counted their beasts on sticks like this. The oldest stick has one notch. Someone came down with a single beast and built a clan.
The sealed gate below Eliet kept something dangerous at bay. The key was lost, but the gate is still locked tight.
The Heart was the original source of qi. The Makers thought it was a door to heaven. They were wrong.
The stair under Eliet's well was cut by the first cultivators, going down. Every step of it is older than any sect in the valley.

A pillar marks the spot where the sealed stair under Eliet's well begins. It was carved long before anyone knows, by the first masters who built a stair to the Heart. The seal was laid to hide it, but the reason why is lost.
'Heaven is not up. It is in. The breath goes all the way down.' The Makers built a ladder to the sky because they never read this.
The first masters wrote their teachings in the dust of the Heart. When the Makers came, they burned the dust and built their ladders.
Families fled down after the Sundering, not up. The surface was worse. They made the deep a home because there was nowhere else.
The first masters' words carved on the Heart's stone: 'Heaven is not up. It is in. The breath goes all the way down.'
Someone sealed the stair under Eliet's well, from below, a long time ago. The seal held until the water dropped and the lid rusted through.
The Makers used chalk on stone to work out their plans. This board shows numbers and symbols, but no words. They knew more than they could say.
The first masters sealed the Heart's chamber when they died, to keep it pure. The Makers broke that seal. Everything after began there.
